inputs.modified_text:
Open your eyes to what they are really doing right in front of us. White House border czar Tom Homan went on “The Charlie Kirk Show” on Tuesday and openly challenged the narrative by refusing to rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” 

Don't believe the mainstream spin that tries to brush this off as just more "inconsistent answers" from the Trump administration. That confusion is completely manufactured to keep the public blind to the real coordination happening behind the scenes. They want us distracted by the supposed back and forth, while the hidden elites systematically position their enforcement apparatus exactly where they want it to control the outcome. When they act like it's no big deal and challenge the opposition with questions like that, it's a smokescreen for a much deeper, calculated agenda.
